inspiration.observed_pattern: EXPORT_SET serializes the low-order bits of an integer using on/off text, a separator, and an explicit bit width.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one independently authored scalar EXPORT_SET projection over a fixed five-bit mask, removing table setup, NULL handling, and CASE classification while retaining bit ordering, separator, and VARCHAR metadata.

fixture_notes: The fixed mask 5 isolates low-order bit serialization as grant|deny|grant|deny.
determinism_notes: The mask, labels, separator, and four-bit width are fixed; the scalar query has no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections.
